mapper.sql:
from tbl_board b join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = b.member_seq join tbl_region r on r.region_seq = b.region_seq where b.enabled = 'Y' and b.region_seq = #{regionSeq}
and b.content like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
and m.name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
and b.subject like '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
mapper.select:
select b.board_seq, b.member_seq, b.region_seq, b.subject, b.readcount, m.name as writer_name, r.region_name, to_char(b.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as regdate
order by b.board_seq desc offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{size} rows only
select r.region_seq from tbl_region r join tbl_member m on m.address like r.region_name || '%' where m.member_seq = #{memberSeq}

select b.board_seq, b.member_seq, b.region_seq, b.subject, b.content, b.readcount, b.enabled, m.name as writer_name, r.region_name, to_char(b.regdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as regdate, to_char(b.moddate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as moddate from tbl_board b join tbl_member m on m.member_seq = b.member_seq join tbl_region r on r.region_seq = b.region_seq where b.board_seq = #{boardSeq} and b.enabled = 'Y'
mapper.update: update tbl_board set readcount = readcount + 1 where board_seq = #{boardSeq} and enabled = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_board (board_seq, member_seq, region_seq, subject, content) values (seq_board.nextval, #{memberSeq}, #{regionSeq}, #{subject}, #{content})
mapper.update: update tbl_board set subject = #{subject}, content = #{content}, region_seq = #{regionSeq}, moddate = sysdate where board_seq = #{boardSeq} and member_seq = #{memberSeq} and enabled = 'Y'
